sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "fees"."orderslink" AS e, SUM("fees"."rebtotal") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("fees"."rebrate" - "fees"."feerate") AS REAL) / "fees"."feerate")) AS m2 FROM "fees" GROUP BY "fees"."orderslink"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: fees.relative difference of maker rebate rate from fee rate
why: total of total rebate per orders (by orderslink) (additive)
(maker rebate rate - fee rate) / fee rate: the relative difference of two quantities in fraction
average of relative difference of maker rebate rate from fee rate per orders (by orderslink)
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of maker rebate rate from fee rate (all level)
